summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features (Streaming Explanation, Zone Spotlight, Warning Audit Log) plus regression. All specified data-testid contracts and behaviours verified via Playwright against the public preview URL. All core assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: after a preset click triggered by presenterNext there is a chained setTimeout(0) sequence — works but fragile; consider a single effect keyed by presenter.step.

AuditLog refresh timing: audit-flag-total text may briefly read stale after clicking a preset because loadAudit is invoked from runRecommend before recommend completes updating state; harmless but could be resolved with an explicit refetch after the recommend promise resolves.
ExplanationCard.jsx: streaming interval fixed 30ms/word — for long explanations this can take 15-20s; consider adaptive stride when total > N to keep classroom demo snappy (Skip mitigates).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright covered: recommend button → streaming (data-streaming true→false, skip button, why→risks→alternative reveal order, explanation-source streaming…→source:gemini-3-flash). Audit log tab shows entries with audit-entry-time-<idx>, audit-flag-total, audit-refresh-button; audit-tab-badge appears when flags>0; tab-dashboard restores dashboard. Presenter mode step 1→zone-price on / others dim, step 2→zone-comparison, step 3→zone-warnings. Chip override (spotlight-chip-montecarlo) sets on; spotlight-clear-button sets all off; direct panel body click toggles spotlight; clicking sliders inside zone-inputs does NOT hijack spotlight; presenter-stop-button clears all dimming. Concert preset added new audit entries visible at top after refresh.
